create_extractor_for_visualizer: create an extractor for a DensePose visualizer using create_extractor to match the visualizer type
extract_scores_from_instances: extract prediction scores from detectron2 Instances objects with optional index selection
extract_boxes_xywh_from_instances: extract bounding boxes in XYWH format from detectron2 Instances with optional selection
use_densepose_result_extractor: use DensePoseResultExtractor to extract chart results with confidences from DensePose prediction instances
use_nms_filtered_extractor: use NmsFilteredExtractor to filter DensePose instances by IoU threshold before extracting data
